question.text: Managers of a Cat III AIF typically have how many minimum years of experience?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 3.2, most Cat III AIF managers have minimum 5 years of experience in capital markets. The Trap: Lower/higher thresholds are not the stated norm. Cross-Exam Context: Fit-and-proper test overlays this norm (Ch 5). Distributor's Pro-Tip: Check manager's track record on past funds — 5 years is a minimum, not a guarantee.
